description: This file implements the FormService interface for the OpenMRS platform, providing functionalities for form management including CRUD operations, duplication, merging, resource handling, and validation within the OpenMRS API module.

classes.name: FormServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the FormService interface, handling form and form resource management, duplication, merging, retiring, unretiring, and validation within the OpenMRS core API.

methods.name: getForm
methods.description: Retrieves a form by its unique identifier.

methods.name: duplicateForm
methods.description: Creates a duplicate of a given form, including its fields and resources.

methods.name: retireForm
methods.description: Marks a form as retired with a specified reason.

methods.name: unretireForm
methods.description: Unmarks a retired form, making it active again.

methods.name: getAllFieldTypes
methods.description: Fetches all field types, optionally including retired ones.

methods.name: getFieldType
methods.description: Retrieves a field type by ID.

methods.name: getField
methods.description: Retrieves a field by ID.

methods.name: getFormField
methods.description: Retrieves a form field by ID.

methods.name: getFormField
methods.description: Retrieves a form field based on form, concept, ignore list, and force flag.

methods.name: getFieldByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a field by its UUID.

methods.name: getFieldAnswerByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a field answer by UUID.

methods.name: getFieldTypeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a field type by UUID.

methods.name: getFieldTypeByName
methods.description: Retrieves a field type by name.

methods.name: getFormByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a form by UUID.

methods.name: getFormFieldByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a form field by UUID.

methods.name: getAllFields
methods.description: Returns all fields, including retired if specified.

methods.name: getAllFields
methods.description: Returns all fields, including retired if specified.

methods.name: getAllFormFields
methods.description: Returns all form fields.

methods.name: getAllForms
methods.description: Returns all forms, including retired if specified.

methods.name: getAllForms
methods.description: Returns all forms, including retired if specified.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Fetches fields based on multiple filtering criteria.

methods.name: getForm
methods.description: Returns the form with the highest version matching the specified name.

methods.name: getForms
methods.description: Returns forms matching various filters including name, encounter types, and fields.

methods.name: getFormCount
methods.description: Counts forms matching various filters.

methods.name: getPublishedForms
methods.description: Returns all published forms.

methods.name: purgeField
methods.description: Deletes a specific field.

methods.name: purgeField
methods.description: Deletes a specific field, with optional cascade behavior.

methods.name: purgeForm
methods.description: Deletes a form.

methods.name: purgeForm
methods.description: Deletes a form with cascade behaviour and associated resources.

methods.name: purgeFormField
methods.description: Deletes a form field.

methods.name: retireField
methods.description: Retires a field.

methods.name: saveField
methods.description: Saves a field.

methods.name: saveForm
methods.description: Saves a form after validation.

methods.name: saveFormField
methods.description: Saves a form field, handling related complex concepts.

methods.name: unretireField
methods.description: Unretires a field.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Search for fields by fuzzy phrase.

methods.name: getFieldsByConcept
methods.description: Finds all fields associated with a concept.

methods.name: getFormsContainingConcept
methods.description: Finds all forms that contain a given concept.

methods.name: purgeFieldType
methods.description: Deletes a field type.

methods.name: saveFieldType
methods.description: Saves a field type.

methods.name: mergeDuplicateFields
methods.description: Merges duplicate fields based on similarity metrics, consolidating form references.
